Our Story

More Than a Cut.
A Statement.

MSR Gent Salon was born from a singular vision: to bring world-class men's grooming to Kurdistan. Nestled in the heart of Erbil, we've built a sanctuary where every visit is an experience — not just a service.

Our master stylists combine decades of craft with the latest international techniques. Whether it's a sharp fade, a sculpted beard, or a complete transformation — we deliver results that speak louder than words.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 2025  ·  Effective: June 2025

Your privacy matters to us. MSR Gent Salon collects only what is necessary to provide and improve our services. We do not sell your data to third parties.

1. Who We Are

MSR Gent Salon, located at 32 Park, Doside Jami, Erbil, Kurdistan Region 44001, Iraq, is the data controller responsible for your personal information collected through this website and our services.

2. Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of personal data:

  • Contact Information: Name, phone number, and any details you voluntarily provide via booking forms or WhatsApp communications.
  • Booking Data: Appointment date, time, service selected, and special requests.
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, time spent on site, browser type, device type, and general geographic location (via IP address). This data is collected anonymously.
  • Communications: Records of WhatsApp conversations or messages you initiate with us.

We do not collect payment card details. All payment transactions, if any, are handled directly in-person at our salon.

3. How We Use Your Information

  • To confirm, manage, and fulfill your bookings and appointments.
  • To send appointment reminders and follow-up messages via WhatsApp.
  • To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support.
  • To improve our website functionality and user experience.
  • To comply with legal obligations under applicable Iraqi and Kurdistan Region law.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your personal data based on: (a) performance of the contract for services you have requested; (b) your explicit consent where required; and (c) our legitimate interest in operating and improving our business.

5. Data Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share data only with:

  • WhatsApp (Meta Platforms) as the communication channel you initiate.
  • Analytics service providers who process data on our behalf under strict confidentiality.
  • Competent authorities if required by law.

6. Data Retention

Booking records are retained for 12 months from the date of appointment for operational and legal compliance purposes. Usage analytics data is retained for a maximum of 26 months in anonymized form.

7. Your Rights

You have the right to: access your personal data, correct inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, object to processing, and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact us via WhatsApp or in person at our salon.

8. Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Booking data stored locally on this website is held in your browser's local storage and is not transmitted to external servers.

9. Children's Privacy

Our services and website are intended for individuals aged 16 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 without verifiable parental consent.

10. Contact

For privacy-related queries: WhatsApp +964 750 555 1215 or visit us at 32 Park, Doside Jami, Erbil, Kurdistan 44001, Iraq.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: June 2025  ·  Effective: June 2025

1. What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences and understand how you interact with their content. Similar technologies include local storage, session storage, and web beacons.

2. Cookies We Use

This website uses the following categories of browser-side storage:

  • Essential / Functional (localStorage): Used to save your booking form entries, theme preference (dark/light/warm mode), and appointment data. These are stored locally in your browser and are required for the website to function correctly. No personal data is transmitted to external servers via these mechanisms.
  • Preference Cookies: Remember your display theme selection so you do not have to reselect it on each visit.
  • Analytics Cookies (if applicable): If third-party analytics tools are integrated, they may place cookies to help us understand aggregate visitor behavior. These do not identify you personally.
This website does not currently use advertising, tracking, or third-party marketing cookies. The embedded Instagram and YouTube content on this site may set their own cookies subject to Meta's and Google's respective cookie policies.

3. Third-Party Cookies

Embedded content from Instagram (Meta) and YouTube (Google) may set third-party cookies when you interact with those embeds. We have no control over these cookies. Please review:

  • Meta Platforms Cookie Policy: facebook.com/privacy/policies/cookies
  • Google Cookie Policy: policies.google.com/technologies/cookies

4. Managing Cookies

You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse, delete, or block cookies. Please note that disabling essential local storage may impact the functionality of our booking system and theme preferences.

Instructions for major browsers: Chrome · Firefox · Safari

5. Your Consent

By continuing to use this website, you consent to the use of essential local storage as described in this policy. For any optional analytics cookies, we will seek your explicit consent where required by applicable law.

6. Updates

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add new features or as applicable law changes. Check this page periodically for the latest version.

Cancellation & Refund Policy

Last updated: June 2025  ·  Effective: June 2025

We understand that plans change. Our policy is designed to be fair to both clients and our team, whose time and expertise are reserved specifically for you.

1. Appointment Cancellations

We operate on an appointment-first model. If you need to cancel or reschedule:

  • More than 24 hours before your appointment: Full cancellation with no charge. Rescheduling is welcome at no additional fee.
  • Less than 24 hours before your appointment: A late cancellation may result in forfeiture of any deposit paid, or a cancellation fee equivalent to 50% of the booked service price at our discretion.
  • No-show (no notification): The full service amount may be charged. Repeat no-shows may result in restricted booking access.

2. How to Cancel

To cancel or reschedule, contact us as early as possible via:

  • WhatsApp: +964 750 555 1215
  • Phone: +964 750 555 1215
  • In-person at our salon.

Cancellations submitted via our website booking form are acknowledged but may take up to 2 hours to confirm. WhatsApp is the fastest channel.

3. Salon-Initiated Changes

In the rare event that we must cancel or reschedule your appointment due to staff illness, force majeure, or operational circumstances, we will notify you at the earliest opportunity and offer the next available slot at no penalty to you. Any prepayment will be fully refunded or credited toward your rescheduled appointment.

4. Refund Policy

MSR Gent Salon is a service-based business. Our refund policy operates as follows:

  • Prepaid deposits: Fully refundable if cancellation is made more than 24 hours in advance. Non-refundable for cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows.
  • Completed services: Refunds are not provided for services that have been fully performed. If you are dissatisfied with a service outcome, please raise your concern with our manager during your visit or within 48 hours. We will offer a complimentary correction appointment at our discretion.
  • Products purchased in-salon: Unopened products purchased at our salon may be returned within 7 days with proof of purchase for a full refund or exchange. Opened products are non-refundable unless faulty.

5. Service Dissatisfaction

Client satisfaction is our highest priority. If you are not satisfied with the result of your service, please inform our team before leaving the salon. We will make every reasonable effort to correct the issue at no additional charge during the same visit.

Claims raised after leaving the salon will be assessed on a case-by-case basis. We reserve the right to determine whether a complimentary correction is appropriate based on the nature of the concern.

6. Force Majeure

Neither party shall be held liable for failure to perform obligations due to circumstances beyond reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, power outages, government-mandated closures, or civil unrest in the Erbil region.

7. Contact for Refund Requests

For any refund or cancellation request, contact: WhatsApp +964 750 555 1215 or visit us in person at 32 Park, Doside Jami, Erbil, Kurdistan 44001, Iraq.
